newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Glass, AlliedSignal in fluorocarbon venture.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Glass, AlliedSignal in fluorocarbon venture.

text.p: Asahi Glass Co Ltd said on Monday that it and AlliedSignal Inc of the United States had agreed to set up a joint venture in Japan to market non-ozone-depleting fluorocarbon products.

The new firm is expected to be set up in the second quarter of this year with capital of 20 million yen. Asahi Glass will hold 49 percent in the venture, while AlliedSignal will hold the rest, Asahi Glass said in a statement.
The fluorocarbon products are used for air-conditioning, commercial refrigeration and foam-insulation applications, the statement said.
The joint venture will also market the products in other Asian countries, the statement said.
